latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Music to Video AI — Convert Music Tracks into Videos.

- Convert audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 music-synced videos within 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic cloud setup: seamless user authentication with free credits and session management.
- Simple command-based actions for uploading, exporting, credits checks, and timeline state.
- Robust error handling for file limits, missing headers, and expired tokens.
- Supports rapid batch processing and iterative video editing workflows.
